# The Lo Down with Isha Lo

> Equipping people to live, work, and lead in the Distributed Intelligence™ era.

The Lo Down with Isha Lo is an executive AI leadership training and change management consulting business founded by Isha Lo, a Global Transformation Strategist. The company serves leaders and organizations in Dallas | Fort Worth, and runs a mission to transform the digital wellness of 1,000,000 women by May 2027.

## What we offer
- AI Leadership Lab — a 2½-hour applied session, in person or virtual.
- Leading AI with Human Intelligence™ Certification — a 12-CPD-hour accredited certification.
- Executive AI Leadership Forum — partnership opportunities to help build the Forum.
- Distributed-Intelligence Leadership™ framework — for leaders building teams of humans and AI.
- Change management consulting across human, business, and community transformation.
